question: Can the strict positive plan-construction subset be certified prospectively from existing read surfaces without new runtime persistence?

sourceAudit.writer: recordTradeJournalDay() uses one ISO now value for v8_trade_journal_days.updated_at, every v8_trade_journal_plans.recorded_at, and returned journal.recordedAt.
sourceAudit.scanEmbedding: V8.5 patch inserts the returned journal object into the same after-market scan summary before LAST_SCAN_KEY persistence.
currentReadSurfaces: /api/scan/status -> latest mutable scan summary including embedded journal receipt
mutationGuards: A later same-date rerun rewrites journal timestamps; if LAST_SCAN was not rewritten too, timestamp mismatch fails closed.
journal/backfill-latest rewrites D1 journal but does not refresh embedded scan.journal, so mismatch fails closed.
staged historical recovery inherits a simulated dry-run journal receipt and therefore cannot enter the certified subset.

conclusion.interpretation: recordedAt is a contemporaneous same-write lineage token for the currently accessible scan generation, not an immutable generation identifier or cryptographic decision fingerprint.

PLAN_CONSTRUCTION_COMPLETE_CURRENT_GENER: health selectedCount and planCount equal scan.selectedCount
all exact-date plan rows surfaced and recorded_at equals the same token
symbols and required plan values match scan.stocks
PLAN_CONSTRUCTION_UNKNOWN: historical generation no longer represented by LAST_SCAN

safeUse.allowed: Prospective coverage-only classification of the latest accessible Formal scan generation; no returns, BUY outcomes or threshold tuning.
forbidden: Treating scanDate+symbol alone as generation identity
Backfilling historical completeness from current KV
Treating UNKNOWN as failure or zero
Using this scan↔journal linkage to certify Shadow↔journal cross-store identity

engineering.classBStillNeeded: Immutable multi-generation archival identity if historical all-generation reconstruction or cross-store joins are required.
engineering.classC: No selection, sizing, threshold, quota, monitoring or trade behavior change.
